title: Aniccam
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pa || ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan ti || || 4 Yaṃ kho bhikkhu aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo ti || || Aññātaṃ Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || || 5 Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6 Rūpaṃ kho bhante aniccaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || Vedanā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || Viññāṇam aniccam || tatra me chando pahātabbo || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || || 7 Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu aniccaṃ || tatra kho te chando pahātabbo || || Vedanā aniccā || || Saññā || || Saṅkhārā || || Viññāṇam aniccaṃ || tatra kho te chando pahātabbo || || Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || [page 077] XXII. 68. 4] ARAHATTAVAGGO DUTIYO 77 8-9 ||Pa || || Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti || ||
